scenes.label: sign-in
scenes.line: Type the email address for your back-office account. {0.8} Then click Send Code.

scenes.label: enter-the-code
scenes.line: A four-digit code is sent to that address. {0.5} Type it in — the screen moves on by itself.

scenes.label: dashboard
scenes.line: This is your dashboard. {0.8} A requirement belongs to one store, so we start at Businesses.

scenes.label: find-the-business
scenes.line: Type the name of a business, {0.5} then select it from the dropdown list.

scenes.label: the-business
scenes.line: This is the business info page. {0.5} Click the lookup icon to find its stores.

scenes.label: find-the-store
scenes.line: Type the store name, {0.5} then select it from the list.

scenes.label: the-store
scenes.line: Now you are on the store details page. {0.8} Click the gear, {0.5} then choose Lookup Requirements.

scenes.label: requirement-list
scenes.line: This lists the store's requirements. {0.5} Click the plus button to add a new one.

scenes.label: new-requirement
scenes.line: Give the requirement a name. {0.5} A good name says which items it is for. {0.5} Then create it.

scenes.label: requirement-details
scenes.line: A requirement is a set of questions the renter must answer. {1} Open the question picker, {0.8} and tick each one you need. {1} We add three: {0.8} the skier's age, {0.8} their boot size, {0.8} and the rental agreement. {1} Then set the status to Active, {0.8} and update.

scenes.label: saved
scenes.line: That is the requirement ready. {0.5} Items can point at it now.

scenes.label: back-to-dashboard
scenes.line: Head back to the dashboard. {0.5} You can get here anytime with the command + K short keys.

scenes.label: sign-out
scenes.line: Click Logout to finish. {0.5} You are signed out.
